test.create_query: CREATE TABLE promql_row_cost_ts ENGINE = TimeSeries SAMPLES INNER ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp) TAGS INNER COLUMNS (id Tuple(UInt64, UUID))
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_row_cost_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'rowcost_metric', map('instance', toString(number), 'dc', toString(number % 8)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000000 + step * 15, 3), toFloat64(step % 977)), range(4096)) FROM numbers_mt(12800)
test.query: SELECT sum(value) FROM timeSeriesSelector('promql_row_cost_ts', 'rowcost_metric', 1000000, 1061440) SETTINGS max_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_row_cost_ts', 'sum(rowcost_metric)', 1000000, 1061440, 10000) SETTINGS max_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(value) FROM timeSeriesSelector('promql_row_cost_ts', 'rowcost_metric{{dc="0"}}', 1000000, 1061440) SETTINGS max_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
